title: Maersk launches Tangier-Casablanca rail service to bypass Casablanca port congestion
summary: Maersk made Tangier its primary maritime gateway for Morocco and launched a high-frequency rail service to Casablanca, bundling ocean leg, rail, customs clearance, inland storage and final-mile trucking under one contact. Casablanca handles ~35% of Moroccan port traffic (17m tonnes in H1 2026) and suffers congestion. Positions Maersk as an integrated inland operator in a market where DP World holds no major terminal, leveraging Tanger Med (where APM Terminals operates).

title: Maersk reshapes Western Mediterranean-West Africa network with new WAF1 Algeciras-Tangier-Dakar shuttle
summary: Effective third week of December 2026, Maersk adds a new WAF1 service linking Algeciras, Tangier and Dakar, revises WAF3 (adding Tema, Onne, Pointe-Noire), WAF5 (Monrovia, Abidjan, Takoradi, San-Pedro, Lagos) and WAF6 (adding Cotonou). The restructuring strengthens direct hub-and-spoke links from Maersk's Western Med transshipment hubs into West and Central Africa, competing with Unifeeder/DP World and MSC regional services.

title: Greta Shipping joins Maersk's Salalah-Mogadishu East Africa feeder (HAX/Musafir Express)
summary: From mid-October 2026 Greta Shipping becomes a vessel provider on Maersk's weekly Salalah-Mogadishu feeder, each party initially deploying one ship (~1,700 and ~2,500 TEU); Greta plans a second vessel in January 2027 replacing Maersk tonnage. Greta simultaneously launched standalone Salalah-Khor Fakkan, India-Port Sudan and India-Sohar services. Shows Maersk sharing Horn of Africa feeder exposure with a regional partner while maintaining Salalah hub connectivity.

title: AP Moller Capital closes MAD 2.2bn (~USD 243m) Morocco transport & logistics fund
summary: APM Capital Morocco, the local arm of A.P. Moller Capital (A.P. Moller Holding affiliate), reached final close on a MAD 2.2bn fund with MAD 1.64bn from the Mohammed VI Investment Fund and other investors plus MAD 600m from AP Moller Capital's Emerging Markets Infrastructure Fund II. Pipeline targets express logistics, 3PL, air cargo handling and cold storage in Morocco, where warehousing supply is thin. Note: AP Moller Capital is a sister entity to Maersk, not Maersk Logistics itself.

title: Maersk opens Belcon cold store in Cape Town, completing USD 100m+ South African cold-chain programme
summary: Maersk officially opened its Belcon cold store with direct access to the Port of Cape Town, the third facility (after Cato in Durban and PreCool in Johannesburg) in a >USD 100m (R1.7bn) South African cold-chain investment totalling 32,000 pallet positions, with rail sidings, an on-site container depot and renewable energy. Targets citrus and table-grape exporters. Makes Maersk the leading integrated reefer logistics provider in SA, where DP World has limited cold-chain presence.

title: Maersk inaugurates first integrated logistics hub in Senegal (Dakar)
summary: Maersk opened a 10,000 sqm warehouse between the Port of Dakar and the industrial zone, with 5,100 sqm indoor storage (7,036 pallet positions) and 500 sqm outdoor space, offering palletising, order processing, labelling and distribution for FMCG, retail and tech cargo, with 60% solar power and electric MHE. Expands Maersk's West African warehousing network to >100,000 sqm across eight countries, competing with DP World's Dakar port-logistics footprint.

title: Maersk opens 35,000 sqm Rotterdam cold store next to APM Terminals Maasvlakte II
summary: Maersk welcomed its first customer (South Africa's Grape Alliance) at a new ~35,000 sqm cold store with >34,000 pallet positions on Maasvlakte, adjacent to APM Terminals MVII and the expanded Star Depot for reefer returns. Features a customs-bonded warehouse, in-house veterinary inspection point and BREEAM Excellent rating. Establishes Maersk's Northwest Europe reefer/pharma hub, tied to its Africa-Europe fruit trades.

title: Maersk inaugurates SAR 1.3bn Jeddah Islamic Port logistics park, largest in the Middle East
summary: Maersk and Saudi Ports Authority (Mawani) inaugurated a 225,000 sqm integrated logistics park at Jeddah Islamic Port, 18 months after groundbreaking, with capacity for 200,000 TEU/yr, bonded storage, refrigerated food warehousing, transshipment, air freight/forwarding space and an e-commerce centre, powered up to 70% by rooftop solar. Positioned as Maersk's Red Sea gateway, directly adjacent to DP World's Jeddah South Container Terminal.

title: Maersk builds Rs 113 crore dedicated cold store for HyFun Foods in Gujarat
summary: Maersk announced a 260,000 sq ft, 14,700-pallet single-shed cold store at Fanidhar Mega Food Park, Mehsana, built exclusively for frozen-food exporter HyFun Foods as a mother cold store integrated with Maersk's rail/road-to-port, customs and ocean services. Uses ammonia refrigeration, solar power and PIR insulation. Illustrates Maersk's customer-anchored cold-chain build-out in India, a market where DP World also runs cold stores and ICDs.

title: DHL Supply Chain leases 240,000 sq ft Bengaluru warehouse at Rs 6.77 crore/yr
summary: DHL Supply Chain signed a five-year lease (three-year lock-in) registered 10 July 2026 for ~2.4 lakh sq ft of warehousing in Bengaluru at Rs 23.50/sq ft/month, rent commencing 1 November 2026. Part of DHL's ~EUR 1bn India build-out to 2030.

title: DHL eCommerce to acquire Baltic parcel operator Venipak
summary: DHL announced the acquisition of Venipak, a parcel, parcel-locker, express and freight provider across Lithuania, Latvia and Estonia, to strengthen its Baltic last-mile network amid e-commerce growth. Terms undisclosed; subject to regulatory approval.
source_name: India Seatrade News / DHL Group press release

title: DHL Group commits ~EUR 160m to France for 2026-2027 (new Supply Chain warehouses, fleet electrification)
summary: Announced at the Choose France summit: EUR 160m across Express, Global Forwarding, Freight and Supply Chain, including new DHL Supply Chain warehouses in southern Paris, Orleans and Lyon, a 4PL control tower in Toulouse and six Freight real-estate projects by 2030. Brings DHL's 2018-2027 French investment to ~EUR 900m.

title: DHL Supply Chain to invest R220m in Gauteng multi-user distribution hub
summary: DHL Supply Chain announced a R220m (~USD 12m) multi-user distribution hub in Gauteng, South Africa, the first concrete project under DHL Group's EUR 300m+ Sub-Saharan Africa commitment, with South Africa named as the core Supply Chain market. Details drawn from headline only; full article not fetched.

title: DHL opens MEA Innovation Center and commits EUR 120m to 55,000 sqm Dubai South contract-logistics warehouse
summary: DHL opened a 1,700 sqm Innovation Center (one of four globally) and announced a EUR 120m, 38-year-lease multi-user warehouse of 55,000 sqm on a 96,000 sqm plot in Dubai South logistics district next to Al Maktoum International Airport, targeting high-value goods under net-zero-carbon operations. Groundbreaking Q1 2026, completion summer 2027. Direct competitor to Jafza/Dubai South positioning of DP World's warehousing offer.

title: DHL Supply Chain to build EUR 130m regional hub as anchor tenant at Riyadh's Special Integrated Logistics Zone (SILZ)
summary: DHL Supply Chain signed a long-term land lease with SILZ for a 78,000 sqm site with 53,000 sqm of multi-user warehousing, 8 km from King Khalid International Airport via a bonded corridor, serving tech, retail, automotive, energy and e-commerce customers for KSA and the wider MEA. Construction Q1 2026, completion Q2 2027; part of DHL's EUR 500m Middle East plan.

title: DHL Group to invest ~EUR 1bn in India by 2030 across all divisions
summary: DHL announced a ~EUR 1bn multi-year programme to 2030 covering a Supply Chain health-logistics hub in Bhiwandi, Blue Dart's largest integrated low-emission facility in Bijwasan and a ground hub in Haryana, an automated Express sort centre in Delhi, an EV/battery logistics centre of excellence (Chennai, Mumbai) and an IT services centre in Indore. Focus on life sciences, new energy, e-commerce and digitalisation.

title: DHL Group commits EUR 300m+ to Sub-Saharan Africa (gateways, aviation capacity, cold chain, Supply Chain in SA)
summary: DHL announced a multi-year EUR 300m+ Sub-Saharan Africa programme: Express gateway upgrades and aviation capacity reaching AfCFTA second cities (recent growth cited in Ethiopia and Nigeria), Global Forwarding energy/project and perishables cold chain, Supply Chain capacity centred on South Africa, plus GoTrade SME programmes and renewable-energy pilots. Reinforces DHL's air-express dominance in Africa against DP World's port-led logistics model.
source_name: STAT Times / DHL Group press release

title: DHL Supply Chain acquires US final-mile healthcare specialist SDS Rx
summary: DHL Supply Chain North America agreed to acquire SDS Rx, a final-mile pharmacy and healthcare delivery provider with 200+ US locations, its second healthcare deal of 2025 after CryoPDP, under DHL's EUR 2bn global healthcare logistics push. Terms undisclosed.

title: DHL eCommerce completes minority stake in Saudi parcel operator AJEX, with option to take majority
summary: DHL eCommerce finalised a minority investment in AJEX Logistics Services (Ajlan & Bros Holding), which operates 60+ facilities, ~1,200 vehicles and ~2,000 staff in Saudi Arabia; DHL gains a board seat and an option to move to majority control. AJEX rebrands as 'AJEX, a partner of DHL eCommerce'. Part of DHL's EUR 500m Middle East plan, targeting Saudi e-commerce growth.

title: DHL earmarks EUR 500m for healthcare logistics in Africa and the Middle East over five years
summary: DHL said roughly a quarter of its EUR 2bn global healthcare logistics programme (~EUR 500m / USD 575m) will go to Africa and the Middle East over five years, expanding ultra-cold storage, serialisation and pharma warehousing at hubs in South Africa, Egypt, Kenya, Dubai and Saudi Arabia.

title: DHL Group to invest more than EUR 500m in Saudi Arabia and UAE through 2030
summary: Under Strategy 2030, DHL committed EUR 500m+ (2024-2030) to KSA and UAE: Express hubs, gateways and aviation capacity; Global Forwarding fleet/EV expansion and the Etihad Rail JV; Supply Chain warehousing in UAE and KSA; and the DHL eCommerce acquisition of AJEX. Includes solar, EV and SAF initiatives. The umbrella commitment behind the Riyadh SILZ and Dubai South projects.

title: DHL Supply Chain acquires US e-commerce fulfilment provider IDS Fulfillment
summary: DHL Group announced the acquisition of IDS Fulfillment, a US omnichannel/e-commerce fulfilment company, to expand DHL Supply Chain's fulfilment network for mid-market brands. Terms undisclosed. Press release seen in search results only; details not fetched.

title: Agility sells 100% of Tristar energy logistics to India's Aegis Logistics at USD 1.5bn enterprise value
summary: Agility Global agreed to sell its entire stake in Dubai-based Tristar (30+ countries, 1,000+ trucks, 26 ocean/coastal vessels, 14 fuel farms, 60+ remote fuel sites, 2025 revenue USD 1.4bn, EBITDA USD 257m) to Aegis Logistics for USD 1.5bn EV / USD 882m equity (~6.0x EBITDA). Closing expected by March 2027. Agility's second major exit after selling GIL to DSV in 2021; proceeds to fund growth, deleveraging and shareholder returns, sharpening its focus on Logistics Parks and Menzies.

title: Agility and Parallel Systems agree to bring autonomous battery-electric rail freight to GCC and EMEA
summary: Agility's corporate venture arm and US autonomous rail company Parallel Systems agreed to jointly develop, finance and deploy Parallel's battery-electric autonomous rail platform (port shuttles, inland links, 500-mile range) across the GCC, EMEA and other markets, starting with corridor identification and regulatory roadmaps. Chairman Tarek Sultan cited Saudi Red Sea gateways and Gulf/Arabian Sea ports as targets to ease congestion and dwell times. No financial terms.

title: Agility Logistics Parks acquires strategic Saudi land parcel; land bank reaches ~4.5m sqm (6.1m incl. JVs)
summary: In its Q2 2026 results Agility reported ALP revenue +47% and EBIT +69% as new Saudi warehouses began generating income, the purchase of a strategic land parcel in Saudi Arabia, and an owned/leased land bank of ~4.5m sqm (~6.1m sqm including JVs with ROSHN, Ardco and Hassan Allam). The Saudi land bank doubled during 2026; Africa occupancy also improved. Tristar also completed an USD 800m syndicated refinancing in the quarter.

title: Agility Logistics Park Tema (Ghana) earns EDGE Advanced; ALP Africa network spans Abidjan, Maputo, Lagos and Cairo
summary: All five warehouses at Agility's 160,000 sqm park in the Tema Free Zone next to Tema port were certified EDGE Advanced (68% energy and 38% water savings vs market), taking ALP's certified warehouses to 17 across every country it operates in. The release confirms ALP's African footprint: Abidjan 470,000 sqm, Maputo 320,000 sqm, Lagos 270,000 sqm (under development) and Yanmu East Cairo 270,000 sqm (JV with Hassan Allam Utilities), the main private logistics-park competitor to DP World's zone developments in West Africa.
capacity: 160,000 sqm (Tema); Abidjan 470,000 sqm; Maputo 320,000 sqm; Lagos 270,000 sqm; Cairo 270,000 sqm

title: Agility Logistics Parks delivers record 226,000 sqm of new warehousing in Jeddah and Riyadh in 2025
summary: Agility Global's FY2025 results show ALP completed ~226,000 sqm of new Grade-A warehouse space in Jeddah and Riyadh in 2025, its highest single-year delivery, with revenue +13% to USD 59m, adjusted EBIT +11% to USD 41m and an exit run-rate of ~USD 86m. Demand strongest in Saudi Arabia; ALP pursuing selective growth in Africa. Group revenue USD 5.1bn, net profit USD 240m.

title: ROSHN (PIF) and Agility Logistics Parks launch SAR 2.5bn 50:50 JV for 1.3m sqm Jeddah logistics park
summary: Following Heads of Terms signed at the Public Investment Forum in February 2026, ROSHN Group and ALP signed a definitive 50:50 JV to develop a Grade-A logistics park on ~1.3m sqm in Jeddah with ~650,000 sqm of warehousing and commercial space over three phases, valued at SAR 2.5bn+ including land. Construction to start Q4 2026. Significantly scales Agility's Red Sea logistics real estate against DP World's Jeddah logistics ambitions.

title: Agility opens SAR 611m (USD 163m) Jeddah Logistics Park on 576,700 sqm SPGA site
summary: Saudi Transport Minister inaugurated Agility Logistics Parks' Jeddah complex south of the city: six Class-A warehouses with dry and temperature-controlled storage on a 576,700 sqm parcel under a 25-year agreement with the State Properties General Administration, serving retail, consumer goods, automotive, energy and e-commerce distribution.

title: Agility Logistics Parks begins SAR 250m final-phase expansion of Riyadh complex to 551,368 sqm
summary: ALP launched the final phase of its Riyadh warehousing complex, adding 100,000 sqm of Class-A space (first phase operational Q1 2025) to reach 551,368 sqm total, with support from the Royal Commission for Riyadh City, MISA and the Riyadh municipality; expected to create 300 Saudi jobs. Complex includes the GCC's first EDGE Advanced certified warehouse.
